programme.title: Inkheart
programme.desc: What if every time you read aloud, the story came to life? Based on Cornelia Funke's bestselling children's novel, this timeless tale of imagination and adventure centers on a young girl whose father (The Mummy's Brendan Fraser) has a secret ability to bring characters from books to life when he reads them aloud. But when a ruthless villain (The Lord of the Rings' Andy Serkis) from a rare children's fable kidnaps Meggie's father to bring others out of the boundaries of fiction, she and a disparate group of friends both real and magic embark on the kind of adventure she has only read about in books to save him and set things right. Also starring The Da Vinci Code's Paul Bettany and Oscar winners Helen Mirren and Jim Broadbent, 'Inkheart' makes all the mystery, all the danger, and all the adventure jump off the page!

programme.title: The Notebook
programme.desc: Behind every great love is a great story. In Seabrook, South Carolina in the 1940s, teenaged debutante Allie Hamilton and local boy Noah Calhoun spend one passionate, carefree summer together and deeply in love. But when the summer ends, war and duty separate the young couple. Today, an elderly man visits a nursing home to read from his notebook to a woman whose memory is fading. As he spins a tale of two young lovers with their whole lives before them, his beloved Allie relives a long-ago passion that has never died, an unbreakable bond between two ordinary people rendered extraordinary by the strength, power and beauty of true love. Based on the novel by Nicholas Sparks, author of A Walk to Remember and Message in a Bottle.

programme.title: The Losers
programme.desc: An explosive tale of double cross and revenge, "The Losers" centers upon the members of an elite U.S. Special Forces unit sent into the Bolivian jungle on a search and destroy mission. The team--Clay, Jensen, Roque, Pooch and Cougar --find themselves the target of a lethal betrayal instigated from inside by a powerful enemy known only as Max. Presumed dead, the group makes plans to even the score when they're joined by the mysterious Aisha, a beautiful operative with her own agenda. Working together, they must remain deep undercover while tracking the heavily-guarded Max, a ruthless man bent on embroiling the world in a new high-tech global war.

programme.desc: Acclaimed filmmaker Christopher Nolan writes, directs and produces this wartime epic action thriller. Dunkirk opens as hundreds of thousands of British and Allied troops find themselves surrounded by enemy forces in the Northern French City during 1940 World War II. Trapped on the beach with the sea at their backs, they face an impossible situation as the German troops close in. The story unfolds on land, sea and air. RAF Spitfires engage the enemy in the skies above the Channel, trying to protect the defenseless men below. Meanwhile, a quickly assembled British fleet led the legendary evacuation of over 300,000 Allied military forces in what Prime Minister Winston Churchill would call a "miracle of deliverance."

Academy Award nominee Ethan Hawke (Training Day) stars in this gritty, high-octane action thriller alongside actress/music sensation Selena Gomez and Oscar winner Jon Voight (Coming Home). Hawke stars as a former racecar driver, working against the clock and forced into a dangerous mission behind the wheel. Desperately trying to save the life of his kidnapped wife, he commandeers a fast car and its unwitting owner (Gomez), taking them on a high-speed race against time at the command of the unseen mysterious assailant (Voight) holding his wife hostage and watching his every move. To save his wife, he took the job. To keep her alive, he'll take control.

programme.title: Jack The Giant Slayer

When a young farmhand unwittingly opens a gateway between our world and a fearsome race of giants, an ancient war is reignited. Unleashed upon the Earth, the marauding giants strive to reclaim the land they once lost, forcing Jack into the battle of his life to stop them. Fighting for a kingdom and its people -- and the love of a princess, of course -- he comes face to face with the legendary goliaths and, in the process, become a legend himself.

Nearly defenseless in the face of the relentless enemy, the forces of mankind have no choice but to turn to two unlikely heroes -- a washed up former pilot and an untested trainee -- who now stand as earth's final hope against the mounting apocalypse.

programme.desc: A new live-action adventure from director David Yates (Harry Potter films) brings Edgar Rice Burroughs' legendary character back to the big screen. It's been years since the man once known as Tarzan (Alexander Skarsgard --True Blood) left the jungles of Africa behind for a gentrified life as John Clayton III, Lord Greystoke, with his beloved wife, Jane (Margot Robbie --The Wolf of Wall Street) at his side. Now, he has been invited back to the Congo to serve as a trade emissary of Parliament, unaware that he is a pawn in a deadly convergence of greed and revenge, masterminded by the Belgian, Captain Leon Rom (Oscar® winner Christoph Waltz). But those behind the murderous plot have no idea what they are about to unleash.

programme.title: The Conjuring 2

Reprising their roles, Oscar® nominee Vera Farmiga (Bates Motel) and Patrick Wilson, star as Lorraine and Ed Warren, who, in one of their most terrifying paranormal investigations, travel to north London to help a single mother raising four children alone in a house plagued by malicious spirits. The film follows the phenomenal worldwide reception of director James Wan's The Conjuring, which marked the largest opening ever for an original horror movie. It went on to make more than $319 million worldwide and still remains the second highest grossing original horror movie of all time, second only to The Exorcist

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.102: Bada-Bam / The Barbamartians
programme.desc: Barbabright captured a melody from Mars. The Barbapapas build a rocket to go to the red planet. // While travelling to Mars, the Barbapapas meet a family of Barbamartians. They have no time to get acquainted when a giant plant attacks the village.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 Ep.210: Barbazoo's Diary / The Great Reporter
programme.desc: Barbazoo have plenty of things to write about in his diary! // After reading the biography of Nellie Bly, Barbalib is determined to become a Great Reporter!

programme.title: Santiago of the Seas S1 Ep.118: Triton's Trumpet / The Curse of the Pirate Baby
programme.desc: Santiago and crew must retrieve a powerful undersea artifact after it's stolen by Enrique. // Bonnie Bones transforms into a baby and it's up to the good pirates to change her back.

programme.title: Santiago of the Seas S1 Ep.117: Santiago and Bonnie to the Rescue / The Compass Caper
programme.desc: After getting stranded at the bottom of a crevice, Bonnie and Santiago must team up to save the day. // Santiago is on a mad dash to get his compass back after it's nabbed by Bonnie Bones and Sir Butterscotch.

programme.title: Blue's Clues & You S1 Ep.103: Playdate with Magenta
programme.desc: Blue's friend Magenta is coming over today! We play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to do with Magenta. During our search for clues, we identify opposites and check out animal footprint with our friends Shovel & Pail.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.213: The Time Capsule
programme.desc: Peppa and her school friends are making a time capsule. They each put one of their favourite things inside and bury it in the school garden. The children discover that their parents made a time capsule many years ago.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.214: Recycling
programme.desc: Peppa and George help Mummy Pig tidy up the breakfast things. Mummy Pig tells them that bottles go into a special green box to be recycled. Old newspapers go in a red box and tins go in a blue box. Peppa and George have fun filling the boxes.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.215: Daddy Pig's Office
programme.desc: Peppa and George are visiting Daddy Pig’s office today. Daddy Pig works with Mr Rabbit and Mrs Cat. Mr. Rabbit’s job is all about numbers, Mrs Cat‘s job is all about drawing shapes on the computer, and Daddy Pig’s job is complicated.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.216: Pirate Island
programme.desc: Grandpa and Granny Pig are taking Peppa, George and their friends to Pirate Island. Grandpa shows how to use his metal detector to find treasures and they all build a big sandcastle.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.217: Jumble Sale
programme.desc: Peppa’s playgroup is holding a jumble sale to raise money for a new roof and Madame Gazelle asks everyone to bring something to sell. Peppa and her friends bring in an old toy but they soon realise that favourite toys can be hard to let go of.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.218: Swimming
programme.desc: Peppa and her family are at the swimming pool. Rebecca Rabbit is there too. She and Peppa are very proud of their swimming skills. Everyone is surprised to discover that Daddy Pig is very good at swimming and diving. Very good indeed.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.219: Foggy Day
programme.desc: Mummy and Daddy Pig are taking Peppa and George to play in the playground. On the way it gets a bit foggy, and soon it is so foggy they can’t see. They decide to go home. But which way is home?

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.220: George's Birthday
programme.desc: Today is George’s birthday and Mummy and Daddy Pig have a special day planned. George gets a new Brontosaurus toy and the family go to the museum to see lots of different dinosaurs.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.221: Tiny Creatures
programme.desc: Peppa and George are playing in Grandpa Pig's garden when they find a little snail. Then Grandpa also shows them his beehive.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.222: Sports Day
programme.desc: It is Sports Day at Peppa’s playgroup. There are lots of exciting events, including running, jumping and the “tug of war”. Daddy Pig tells Peppa that it’s not the winning that matters.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.223: GrandDad Dog's Garage
programme.desc: Peppa’s car runs out of petrol but thankfully Granddad Dog’s garage isn’t far away. With one phone call, Granddad Dog is on his way. He tows Peppa’s car back to his garage.

programme.title: DORA S4 Ep.410: Octo-Swiper / Tudos Juntos
programme.desc: Dora stops a frantic octopus Swiper and saves the Pearl Day Party! // Dora meets Raquel the Rock Lobster and helps her get the missing instruments back in time to play at the big music show!

programme.title: Dora S2 Ep.205: The Cloud Kingdom
programme.desc: Dora and Boots meet Vicky the Vicuña who is missing her magic flute that she needs to go back to the Cloud Kingdom.

programme.title: Mr. Crocodile S1 Ep.101: Lucky Croc / Sleepover Croc
programme.desc: Daisy and Mr. Crocodile search for a lucky item to help them win a bike raffle. // When Mr. Crocodile can't fall asleep at his first sleepover, Daisy helps him figure out why.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 Ep.220: The Barbababies Have Got Talent / Triple Switcheroo
programme.desc: Every barbababy is invited to show their greatest talent on stage. // Video games are fun, but you also need to know how to enjoy the nice weather!

programme.title: Barbapapa - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.110: Double Dare You
programme.desc: On a ski trip, the Barbapapas build a giant igloo. Barbabravo and Barbalib challenge each other to find out who is braver.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S1 Ep.114: The Crew Builds A Splash Park / The Crew Builds A Playroom
programme.desc: With their splash park plans in troubled waters, the pups have to get creative to cool down the town for the summer. // As the pups work on building a surprise playroom for Lucas and Lily, a squirrelly visitor causes construction complications.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S3 Ep.302: The Crew Builds A Hotel Elevator
programme.desc: Rubble & Crew steps in to help at Hotel Hadley after a snowy surprise. But when the stairs aren't fast enough, it's time to bow wow build!

programme.title: PAW Patrol S13 Ep.1311: Pups and the Digi Tal Safety Suit / Pups Put a Mouse on the Move
programme.desc: Since Danny's baseball accident, Digi and Tal invent a Safety Suit for him to wear, designed to pop up and protect him from danger. // Francois' fancy fromage goes missing before the competition and it's up to Squeak to lead the rescue!

programme.title: PAW Patrol S3 Ep.311: A Pup in Sheep's Clothing
programme.desc: When little lambs keep running away from Farmer Al’s pasture, it’s up to the Paw Patrol to find the missing sheep.

programme.desc: The gang of mini-heroes cherish the forest in which they live. So, whenever it comes to protecting or helping it, they don't hesitate to join forces and face their fears.

programme.title: My Class Ep.12: The noun and the noun phrase (part 1)
programme.desc: Spelling, grammar, conjugation: these essential French concepts are approached by teachers in a fun way to help children aged 9-12.

programme.title: Woolly Woolly Ep.3: The little walk
programme.desc: Every evening, Lila and her little brother Marco invent extraordinary stories whose heroes are five little gnomes. And the special thing about these gnomes is that they are made of wool and live in a fully woolly world!

programme.title: Ta Vie Sans Ça
programme.desc: What would our lives be like without everyday objects? In each episode, one of them is featured. Whether it is the suitcase, the stopwatch or the fork, they all have a story to tell about their creation and evolution.

programme.title: Jad Et Ses Soeurs Ep.20: Having nightmares
programme.desc: Twin sisters Ranya and Syrine are as adorable as they are inseparable. Their lives are joyful and full of everyday adventures. But everything is about to be turned upside down with the arrival of their little brother, Jad.

programme.title: Capitaine Tonus Ep.2: Why should we make sure we drink enough?
programme.desc: How to eat well, move well, sleep well? In each episode, Captain Stella Tonus of the Body Fleet Federation journeys inside the human body aboard the vessel Positron. Her aim: to teach children about the beneficial or harmful effects of the things they do in their everyday lives.

programme.title: Compostman Et Moi Ep.31: Marcello
programme.desc: Charlie and Zach live in an apartment building with their parents. One day, a friendly monster appears at their home... His name is Compostman and he is directly connected to the planet's needs. Thanks to him, Charlie and Zach will learn everything about ecology.

programme.title: Compostman Et Moi Ep.32: Birthday
programme.desc: Charlie and Zach live in an apartment building with their parents. One day, a friendly monster appears at their home... His name is Compostman and he is directly connected to the planet's needs. Thanks to him, Charlie and Zach will learn everything about ecology.

programme.title: Il Est Une Fois Ep.9: The golden duck of Saint-Jean-Pied-de-Port
programme.desc: What if the characters from the fairy tales of the past were living in today's world? From Marseilles to Brazzaville, via Montreal, we take you on a journey to discover some very special characters. There's a wolf on a motorbike, a Belgian Little Riding Hood and three little Corsican pigs!

programme.title: Les Croquemoutard Ep.1: A hunter's instinct
programme.desc: The Kiddycrunchers are a family of Trolls who have been forced to leave their home under the bridge and move into the Shoebox Housing Project to Iive amongst human beings! They discover community life and find that it isn't easy to live amongst these scrumptious creatures with their odd ways!

programme.title: Cirkus Ep.18: Graduation
programme.desc: Magic Maurice has awarded Sasha his illusionist's certificate. He and Kenzo now have to swap roles.

programme.title: 1001 Mondes Antiques Ep.2: The Coliseum
programme.desc: Braillard, Colombe and Lablatte have discovered a way of travelling back through ancient eras and civilisations. They embark on a journey back in time, passing through popular civilisations such as ancient Egypt and Greece, as well as sub-Saharan Africa, the Middle East and Mesopotamia.

programme.title: Les Super-Pouvoirs Du Vivant Ep.18: The globefish
programme.desc: The animal kingdom is brimming with creatures that have extraordinary powers. To reveal the incredible inventiveness of nature and the importance of protecting it, each episode takes us on a fascinating journey rich in poetry and humour.

programme.title: Football - Ligue 1 Mcdonald'S Ep.7: Lille/Brest
programme.desc: French football championship. Day 7. Lille OSC/Stade Brestois 29. Decathlon Arena - Stade Pierre-Mauroy (Villeneuve d'Ascq). 1st half-time.

programme.title: Football - Ligue 1 Mcdonald'S Ep.7: Lille/Brest
programme.desc: French football championship. Day 7. Lille OSC/Stade Brestois 29. Decathlon Arena - Stade Pierre-Mauroy (Villeneuve d'Ascq). 2nd half-time.

programme.title: Magazine
Basik
programme.desc: The programme which explores and explains the economy, examines our relationship to money and analyses our purchasing power. The economic, social and environmental challenges of tomorrow are covered in a direct, down-to-earth and occasionally mischievous manner!

programme.title: À Bon Entendeur
programme.desc: ABE examines a wide range of topics affecting everyday life in everyday homes: it tests products, compares prices, highlights fraudulent practices, raises consumer awareness and questions manufacturers. The programme addresses economic, social, environmental and health issues and talks about leisure activities, technology...

programme.title: Magazine
Le Téléjournal De Radio-Canada
programme.desc: The televised news programme from the Radio-Canada team.

programme.title: Vivement Dimanche
programme.desc: On his iconic red sofa, Michel Drucker welcomes and shines the spotlight on the talent of yesterday, today and tomorrow. A main guest talks about their career, their projects and their origins...

programme.title: Échappées Belles Ep.34: Tasting Morocco
programme.desc: Morocco, the second most visited country in Africa, stands out for its cuisine, named in 2024 the best in the world by a platform of forty million followers. While couscous and tagines are among its emblematic dishes, Moroccan gastronomy reflects a multitude of cultural and historical influences.

programme.title: Heïdi'S Ice Ep.3: A letter to the glacier
programme.desc: Set against the footage filmed by Pierre Dugowson in the heart of the icy landscape, the glaciologist Heïdi Sevestre reads her "Letter to the Glacier". An ode filled with love and sadness, a description of a never-ending agony.

programme.title: Habitants Du Nord Ep.6: Those who pass this way
programme.desc: Last adventures in Tombstone Territorial Park: the duo decides to do some canoeing and a guided mountain hike. Halfway through the hike, Nadia has to give up but Vincent makes it to the summit.

programme.title: Questions Pour Un Champion
programme.desc: A general knowledge quiz.

programme.title: La Grande Galerie Francophone
programme.desc: Every week and in public, Ali Baddou and his group of columnists receive French-speaking artists who are at the heart of current events and move the lines.

programme.title: Le Journal De France 2
programme.desc: The television news programme of the France 2 editorial board (1 p.m. edition, Paris time).

programme.title: Il Était Une Voix - 100 Ans De Radio
programme.desc: The radio, an invisible thread connecting people, irrespective of the distance between them. A powerful alchemy between technological innovation and human passion. From the first makeshift radio transmitters to the sophisticated filmed radio of the 21st century, a look back over a century of radiophonic adventures in Switzerland.

programme.title: Foot Fm
programme.desc: A revolution in football is underway in Switzerland. From the tenacity of the juniors to participation in the 2015 World Cup, we plunge into the exciting world of the FC Saint-Légier mixed team including portraits of team captain Alicia, her friend and team member Chloé, and their trainer Fred.

programme.title: Futura ! Ep.7: Bodybuilding
programme.desc: Recently, Vanessa started bodybuilding. Her whole life now revolves around her new passion and she wants at all costs to win her next competition. Between big muscles and glitter bikinis, she takes us into a fascinating world where we play with the limits of the human body.

programme.title: Entre Les Bras, La Cuisine En Héritage
programme.desc: In 2009, the famous chef from the Aveyron, Michel Bras, decided to hand over the reins to his son Sébastien. A crucial moment. How to pass on a lifetime's work? And how easy for the son to make his own name? Portrait of an exceptional family spanning three generations.

programme.title: La Copie De Coralie
programme.desc: Manager of a reprographics shop, Mr. Conforme is haunted by the memory of a woman. Witnessing the distress of the employer, Virginie, the assistant, posts a search notice on the walls of the city.

He or she will introduce viewers to people who are dedicating their lives to its protection, inheritance, innovation, development and promotion.

programme.title: The Agenda
programme.desc: A weekly talk-show looking beyond the headlines and “accepted wisdom” to find the real story. Hosted by award-winning journalist and presenter Stephen Cole, The Agenda quite simply sets The Agenda . You won’t find the same-old talking heads recycling platitudes; instead thought-provoking guests to debate and explore key issues of today’s world. Using virtual reality graphics to bring subjects to life, Stephen will navigate through subjects ranging from “Prove That Climate Change Exists” to “Who Will Win the Race to Space”. Opposing views will be given opportunity to flourish and develop into a meaningful conversation. The Agenda: No nonsense talk; Challenging perceptions.

programme.title: Razor
programme.desc: CGTN's brand new science and technology show, covering cutting edge developments from all over the world. RAZOR will show you the world's most powerful laser and the world's smallest anti-cancer treatment. It will take you from the weird world of quantum computing to the boundaries of the cosmos. An international team of reporters will follow the guidance of Occam's Razor - the principle that the simplest explanation is the best one. RAZOR will show that we are already ""living in the future"!
